description: This file contains a Smarty plugin defining the {html_options} function, which generates HTML <select> elements with options based on provided parameters. It includes functions for rendering options and option groups, and handles escaping special characters.

methods.name: smarty_function_html_options
methods.description: Main function to generate HTML select element with options based on parameters.

methods.name: smarty_function_html_options_optoutput
methods.description: Generates individual <option> tags or optgroups based on input.
